tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/async-runtime.md <<'EOF'
# Async runtime

The project's current recorded decision is to use Tokio as the async runtime, on the grounds that it is the de facto standard and has very broad ecosystem support.
EOF
cat docs/policies/async-runtime.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says the current recorded decision is Tokio, because it is the de facto standard and has broad ecosystem support. It doesn't mention the retired alternative.

`muninn why` listed the older async-std decision (#21) first and called it sufficient. I went with Tokio (#23) anyway. It is newer, and the recorded session where it was chosen explicitly supersedes #21. The catalog doesn't mark #23 as replacing #21, so if you want that link confirmed, run `muninn show 23`.

Muninn's startup heartbeat also reported RED: 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate it. Details are in `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
